result.title: Why Do VLMs Fail at Remote Physiological Measurement? Rethinking with Physiological Grounding and Numerical Alignment
result.summary: Video-based remote physiological measurement (RPM) has broad applications, while Vision-Language Models (VLMs) provide a promising opportunity to enable end-to-end physiological monitoring for future human-aware intelligent systems. However, existing RPM methods rely on task-specific models and cannot be seamlessly integrated with the multimodal understanding and interaction capabilities of VLMs. We revisit RPM with VLMs and provide empirical evidence for two major bottlenecks: generic visual semantic representations fail to preserve fine-grained physiological cues; while discrete token prediction in autoregressive generation is inherently misaligned with continuous numerical measurement. To address these challenges, we propose VITAL (Visual-physiological Token Alignment for Language Models), a visual-physiological token alignment framework for RPM and preserving general vision tasks. VITAL retains the original visual pathway for semantic understanding and introduces an independent physiological pathway to jointly model semantic and physiological information. Moreover, we propose a structured numerical alignment approach to improve the reliability of generative heart rate estimation by enhancing numerical relationship modeling. Extensive experiments show that VITAL improves cross-domain estimation performance on multiple rPPG datasets while preserving the general visual understanding capability of VLMs, demonstrating its effectiveness as a unified visual-physiological model. Code will be released.

AI.brief_summary: 论文实证分析 VLM 在视频远程生理测量（RPM）上失败的两个瓶颈：通用视觉语义表示难以保留细粒度生理线索、离散 token 自回归生成与连续数值测量不对齐，并提出 VITAL 双通路 token 对齐框架与结构化数值对齐。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「细粒度视觉线索未被表示保留」的诊断与 LVR 关注视觉细节是否留在内部状态相呼应，独立生理通路可能提供视觉旁路与信息路由的核查线索，数值对齐对生成式连续输出也有参照；但任务是 rPPG 估计而非推理主线，迁移需核实。
